# Tools

These are the tools an AI assistant can use once it is connected to pmsbridge. The same tools work
for every supported property management system. Tools that start with the name of a system (for
example `guesty_`) only work with connections to that system.

- Every tool that works on a connection takes an optional `connection` argument: the name or id of
  the connection, as shown by `list_connections`. It can be left out when the assistant may use only
  one connection.
- An assistant can only use the connections the person chose when they approved it. Asking for any
  other connection gets the same answer as asking for one that does not exist.
- Tools marked "changes data" only work on connections where an administrator has allowed changes
  (see [Allow changes](user-guide.md#allow-changes)). They are never repeated automatically: if one
  times out, the assistant is told the outcome is unknown.
- Lists are limited in size, and every call stops after 25 seconds.
- Tool names, parameters and results are only ever added to in updates, never renamed or removed.

## `get_listing`

**Read only.**

Get one property (listing) by its id.

Returns its name, address, bedrooms, guest capacity, base price, time zone and check-in and check-out times. Fails with a clear message if the listing does not exist.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | string | yes | The listing id from list_listings. |
| `connection` | string (optional) | no | The connection to use: its name or id as shown by list_connections. Optional when only one connection is available. |

## `get_listing_details`

**Read only.**

Get the full content of one property: descriptions, amenities and check-in instructions.

Returns the listing's descriptions, the amenities it has and does not have, how guests check in, and its custom fields, where the property management system has them.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | string | yes | The listing id from list_listings. |
| `connection` | string (optional) | no | The connection to use: its name or id as shown by list_connections. Optional when only one connection is available. |

## `get_reservation`

**Read only.**

Get one reservation by its id, with the guest's contact details and balance.

Returns the dates, status, channel, confirmation code, notes, and, when the property management system provides them, the guest's name, email and phone and the balance the guest still owes. Door and lock codes are never shown. Fails with a clear message if the reservation does not exist.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | string | yes | The reservation id from list_reservations. |
| `connection` | string (optional) | no | The connection to use: its name or id as shown by list_connections. Optional when only one connection is available. |

## `list_connections`

**Read only.**

List the property management connections this AI assistant may use.

Call this first when you do not know which connection to use. Every other tool takes an optional `connection` argument (a label or id from this list); it can be left out when exactly one connection is available. Only connections the person allowed for this assistant are shown.

This tool takes no arguments.

## `list_listing_photos`

**Read only.**

List the photos of one property in display order.

Each photo has an image address, a thumbnail address, a caption and its position. At most 200 photos are returned.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | string | yes | The listing id from list_listings. |
| `connection` | string (optional) | no | The connection to use: its name or id as shown by list_connections. Optional when only one connection is available. |

## `list_listings`

**Read only.**

List the properties (listings) in the property management system.

Returns a page of listings with name, address, bedrooms, guest capacity, base price and check-in times. When next_cursor is set there are more; pass it back as cursor. Use get_listing for one property or get_listing_details for its descriptions and amenities.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `search` | string (optional) | no | Text to look for in the listing title, address or internal note. Omit for all. |
| `active_only` | boolean | no | Only active listings. Use false to also ask for inactive ones (the property management system may still hide some). |
| `limit` | integer (optional) | no | How many listings to return (1 to 100). |
| `cursor` | string (optional) | no | The next_cursor of the previous result, to get the next page. |
| `connection` | string (optional) | no | The connection to use: its name or id as shown by list_connections. Optional when only one connection is available. |

## `list_reservations`

**Read only.**

List reservations, earliest check-in first, optionally filtered.

The earliest check-in comes first (set check_in_from to leave out past bookings). Returns a page of reservations with dates, nights, status, channel, confirmation code and guest count. List results leave out the guest's contact details and the money; use get_reservation for one booking to get them when the property management system provides them. Dates are written YYYY-MM-DD. When next_cursor is set there are more; pass it back as cursor.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | string (optional) | no | Only reservations for this listing id (from list_listings). |
| `statuses` | list of `inquiry` or `pending` or `confirmed` or `checked_in` or `checked_out` or `cancelled` or `declined` or `expired` or `unknown` (optional) | no | Only reservations in one of these statuses: inquiry, pending, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, cancelled, declined, expired or unknown. Omit for every status. |
| `check_in_from` | string (optional) | no | Check-in on or after this day, a date written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `check_in_to` | string (optional) | no | Check-in on or before this day, a date written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `check_out_from` | string (optional) | no | Check-out on or after this day, a date written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `check_out_to` | string (optional) | no | Check-out on or before this day, a date written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `created_from` | string (optional) | no | Booked on or after this day, a date written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `created_to` | string (optional) | no | Booked on or before this day, a date written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `search` | string (optional) | no | A confirmation code or guest name to look for. What is matched depends on the property management system; if a name finds nothing, list by date instead and check the guest on each booking with get_reservation. Omit for all. |
| `limit` | integer (optional) | no | How many reservations to return (1 to 100). |
| `cursor` | string (optional) | no | The next_cursor of the previous result, to get the next page. |
| `connection` | string (optional) | no | The connection to use: its name or id as shown by list_connections. Optional when only one connection is available. |
